trips.name: Evia
trips.description: Or Euboea, is the second-largest Greek island in area and population, after Crete, and in close proximity to Athens. In less than 1.5 hours by bus, train, or car, you can reach Chalkis, or Halkida, the island's capital city and enjoy the local beaches, Ottoman castle on the hill, the promenade with bars & restaurants. From here you can continue to Kymi and take the ferry to Skyros island or choose to explore the islands hidden gems.
